    How we work

    From First Thought to Real Impact.

    1

    Discover

    Understand the business and its goals.

    Workshops, audience research and an honest look at what’s working now.
    2

    Define

    Build the strategy and creative direction.

    Positioning, messaging and the “theory” each campaign is built on.
    3

    Create

    Design, produce, launch, and connect the right tools.

    Identity, content, campaigns and the automations behind them.
    4

    Optimise

    Review performance and improve continuously.

    Clear reporting, regular reviews and steady improvements.

    About The Hype Theory

    We Don’t Create Noise. We Create Meaningful Attention.

    • Creative thinking ✦
    • Strategic planning ✦
    • Visual identity ✦
    • Practical technology ✦

    The Hype Theory is a creative and marketing studio for brands that want to be noticed for the right reasons.

    We bring creative thinking, strategic planning, strong visual identities and practical technology into one team. That means the person shaping your positioning talks to the person designing your identity, and both talk to the person setting up the systems that bring in and follow up your leads.

    We start every project by understanding what the business needs, write down the idea we’re testing, and measure it once it’s live. If something isn’t working, we say so and change it.
